note: Directories first. Contact details change and stale details do the most harm to someone in a hurry, so each entry links to the organization's own page rather than reproducing a phone number here. Inclusion is not an endorsement.

directories.name: EOIR List of Pro Bono Legal Service Providers
directories.what: The official, court-by-court list of organizations and attorneys who have committed to at least 50 hours a year of free legal services. Published quarterly in January, April, July and October.

directories.name: National Immigration Legal Services Directory
directories.org: Immigration Advocates Network and Scale Justice
directories.what: Searchable by state, county, zip code or detention facility. Only nonprofit organizations providing free or low-cost immigration legal services are listed.

organizations.name: Catholic Legal Services, Archdiocese of Miami
organizations.what: Nonprofit law firm representing low-income immigrants. Work permits, applications and removal defense. Formed in part from the G.W.L. Haitian legal services project.

organizations.name: Americans for Immigrant Justice
organizations.what: Nonprofit law firm doing direct representation, impact litigation and advocacy. Recruits pro bono attorneys.

organizations.name: Haitian Bridge Alliance
organizations.what: Haiti-focused advocacy organization providing pro bono legal support and a community hotline. Active on Haiti TPS.

organizations.name: Sant La Haitian Neighborhood Center
organizations.what: Community center serving South Florida's Haitian-American community, with Creole-language programming and a TPS resource center.
organizations.cost: Not stated on the organization's site
organizations.flag: Whether this is direct legal representation or referral is not stated publicly. Call before relying on it.

organizations.name: Family Action Network Movement (FANM)
organizations.what: Community organization with immigration, citizenship and policy programs, adult education and housing advocacy.
organizations.cost: Not stated on the organization's site
organizations.flag: Legal scope and cost are not stated publicly. Call before relying on it.

organizations.name: Florida Immigrant Coalition
organizations.what: Grassroots coalition running legal services, advocacy and a free hotline.
